g.text: This 925 bp unmasked region has 925 − |ℓ| possible A/B position pairs at signed lag ℓ. Zero-signal bases still count.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Calibri', 'Carlito', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #5b6671

g.text: At +10 bp, the normalized DCC is 5/915 ≈ 0.00546; positive lag means B is downstream of A.
